node.prompt: Prepare a plan for a later response recommending which of two fictional rooms can seat five people. North has 4 seats; South has 6 seats. Both are available at no charge. Use only these supplied facts. No external research or external actions are requested. The eventual response must name the qualifying room, state both capacities, and explain the two-seat difference. Stop after Plan for review. Keep each structured field concise. Create a child question only if a material unresolved issue requires one.
